notes.zh:
新增签名更新验证：拒绝被篡改、过期和重放的更新清单。
网页修复更新自动准备，功能更新先确认；涉及 Android 底层时可在 App 内下载并验证 APK，再交给系统确认安装。
新增“版本与更新”和更新公告；公告在实际升级后展示一次，也可随时查看。
继续保持本地项目、离线启动与失败回退。旧版 Preview 请覆盖安装本版。
notes.en:
Signed update verification rejects tampered, expired and replayed metadata.
Web fixes are staged automatically; feature updates ask first. Native app upgrades download and verify an APK before opening Android installation confirmation.
Version & updates controls and local release notes appear once after an actual upgrade and remain available manually.
Local projects, offline startup and rollback are preserved. Install this APK over the previous preview.
